Title: Nikhil and the Family

Cast

1. Nikhil - 8 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Meenakshi - 38 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Rajesh - 36 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Savitri - 65 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "What lovely weather!"

[A hailstorm begins.]

Meenakshi: "That was fun!"

[Hailstones pound the ground.]

Nikhil: "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi and Rajesh stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "So, here we are!"

[Nikhil opens his umbrella.]

Nikhil: "Oh wow!"

[Nikhil puts on his raincoat.]

Meenakshi: "Yes, of course."

[The rain stops.]

Meenakshi: "I knew it!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Meenakshi and Rajesh stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "So, here we are!"

[Nikhil lies down on the sofa.]

Meenakshi: "Hey, look at that!"

[Nikhil sits down on a chair.]

Meenakshi: "Rajesh, listen!"

[Nikhil flops down on the sofa.]

Meenakshi: "Oh wow!"

[Nikhil sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Meenakshi: "Let's see."

Scene 4: The snowy hillside - Day

Nikhil: "So, here we are!"

[Nikhil builds a snowman.]

Nikhil (surprised): "Exactly right."

[Nikhil catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Meenakshi: "That was such a fun day!"
